global.title: Harbinger scores another $240M in latest investment round
global.summary: Electric truck maker Harbinger has been racking up wins in recent months, and after scoring a $300 million order from international shipping giant FedEx and a defense contract with the US military, the company has drummed up another $240 million in Series D funding. more…

global.title: Yamaha’s new electric scooter takes aim at Europe’s 125cc commuters
global.summary: Yamaha is expanding its electric scooter lineup with the new XENTER E, a 125cc-equivalent electric scooter designed specifically with European city riding in mind. more…

global.title: Honda just showed off its first high-end electric mountain bike
global.summary: Honda makes just about everything with a motor, from lawnmowers and generators to cars, motorcycles, and even airplanes. Now the Japanese giant is adding another electrified vehicle to the list – a premium electric mountain bike. more…

global.title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
global.summary: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can. And now, that global push is extending to India. more…

global.title: Apollo’s newest electric scooter is also its lowest-cost yet
global.summary: Apollo has spent the last several years carving out a spot for itself toward the more premium end of the electric scooter market. Now the company is trying something different: going after the mass market with its least expensive model yet. more…

global.title: Hyundai’s $359 IONIQ 5 lease looks like a deal, but don’t overlook its bigger sibling
global.summary: The Hyundai IONIQ 5 is the most popular EV in America outside of Tesla, but its larger three-row sibling looks like the better deal right now. more…

global.title: EVgo opens its first Tesla Superchargers, with hundreds more planned
global.summary: EVgo has opened its first Supercharger station, and it’s in a Chicago grocery store parking lot. The site has 12 fast-charging stalls with both NACS and CCS plugs, and it’s the first of hundreds of Tesla Supercharger stalls EVgo plans to add across the US. more…

global.title: BYD is launching this 5-seat luxury electric SUV next week with over 1,000 km of range
global.summary: BYD’s luxury brand, Denza, calls it “the king of large 5-seater pure electric vehicles.” The new Denza N8 electric SUV will launch next week, offering an impressive CLTC driving range of over 1,000 km (621 miles), massive digital screens, and plenty of premium extras. more…
